title: Location Course Student List – Lesson Allocation Archived – Student Excluded from Both Active and Inactive Tabs; Restored Student Reappears in Active Tab
description: Regression / control case - Decision Table: a student whose Lesson Allocation has been archived is excluded from both the Active and Inactive tabs of the Location Course student list (not just moved from one tab to the other), and reappears correctly in the Active tab once the Lesson Allocation is restored.
preconditions:
- A Location Course exists with Student A and Student B enrolled, both with active Lesson Allocations (End_Date_Time__c in the future).
- Student A's Lesson Allocation is subsequently archived (Archived_At__c populated) after its Student Package Order was fully removed.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Location Course detail and views the Active Student tab"
2. "HQ or CM Staff looks for Student A in the Active Student tab"
3. "HQ or CM Staff switches to the Inactive Student tab"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Active Student tab"
steps_result:
1. "Student B appears in the list"
2. "Student A does not appear"
3. "Student A does not appear here either - an archived Lesson Allocation is excluded from both tabs, not reclassified as Inactive"
4. "Student A's Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
5. "Student A reappears in the list"
steps_data:
1. "Student B Archived_At__c = blank -> included"
2. "Student A Archived_At__c populated -> excluded"
3. "Archived state excluded from both End-Date-based tabs"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Student A Archived_At__c = blank (restored) -> included again"

title: Location Course – Class Assigned to Student – Lesson Allocation Archived – Student Hidden from Lesson; Restored – Student Shown Again
description: Feature Impact (Class Assignment / Master Queue) - Decision Table: a student assigned to a Class via the Location Course "Active Student" flow (case 10541 baseline) disappears from that Class's lesson Student Sessions once their Lesson Allocation is archived, and reappears on the same record once the Lesson Allocation is restored.
preconditions:
- Student A has an active Lesson Allocation for Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ.
- HQ or CM Staff has assigned Class A to Student A via the Location Course Active Student page (effective date = today), and a lesson for Class A exists today - Student A currently appears in that lesson's Student Sessions.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Class A lesson's Student Sessions section"
2. "The Student Package Order behind Student A's Math 101 Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Class A lesson's Student Sessions section"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Math 101 Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Class A lesson's Student Sessions section"
steps_result:
1. "Student A is listed as an active student"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated; Student A's Class Member (created via the Location Course flow) flips to archived via the same formula"
3. "Student A no longer appears in the list"
4. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
5. "Student A reappears in the list - the same original Student Session and Class Member, not newly created"
steps_data:
1. "Student A Is_Archived__c = FALSE -> shown"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Student A Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) -> hidden"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Student A Is_Archived__c = FALSE (restored) -> shown again"

title: Location Course – Class Auto-Assign/Auto-Remove – Lesson Allocation Archived – Future Sessions Hidden, Not Deleted (Unlike Cancel Future Class); Restored – All Future Sessions Reappear
description: Feature Impact (Class Assignment / Master Queue) - Decision Table: contrasts the existing "Cancel Future Class" auto-remove behavior (case 10545/10546, which hard-deletes future Student Sessions via ClassMemberMasterQueueExecutor.removeSessionsByClass) with archiving the Lesson Allocation: LessonAllocationSyncService.executeSyncPlan never calls that cleanup, so future sessions across every lesson instance are only hidden by the Is_Archived__c formula, never deleted - and all of them reappear, same records, once the Lesson Allocation is restored.
preconditions:
- Student A has an active Lesson Allocation for Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ, with Class A assigned (effective date = today, no end date).
- Class A has 3 future lesson instances: 2026-05-21, 2026-05-28, 2026-06-04. Student A currently appears in all 3 as an auto-assigned student (per case 10543's baseline).
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens all 3 future Class A lesson instances and checks Student Sessions"
2. "The Student Package Order behind Student A's Math 101 Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens all 3 future Class A lesson instances"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's 3 Student Session records directly by their record Ids"
5. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Math 101 Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
6. "HQ or CM Staff reopens all 3 future Class A lesson instances"
steps_result:
1. "Student A appears in all 3"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
3. "Student A no longer appears in any of the 3 - but unlike "Cancel Future Class" (case 10545/10546), no Student Session record is deleted; only the Is_Archived__c formula flips"
4. "All 3 records still exist, unmodified aside from the formula-derived Is_Archived__c"
5. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
6. "Student A reappears in all 3 - the same original Student Session records from step 4, not newly created ones"
steps_data:
1. "Student A Is_Archived__c = FALSE -> shown in all 3"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Student A Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) -> hidden in all 3, records preserved"
4. "Records preserved for history/restore, no hard delete occurred"
5. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
6. "Student A Is_Archived__c = FALSE (restored) -> shown again in all 3, same record Ids as before archiving"
